review_candidates.title: Senior Automation Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description Role Summary The Senior Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable infrastructure automation across compute and cloud domains. Key Responsibilities Design and implement reusable automation frameworks (IaC, Ansible). Qualifications And Certifications Bachelors in engineering or computer science.
eligibility_evidence: ServiceNow Integration (Detailed) All automation workflows must integrate with Maaden’s ServiceNow instance: Incident auto-creation with diagnostic data Change requests with pre-checks, back-out plans, post-validation Approval gates via ServiceNow task toggles and standard change templates Full evid
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications And Certifications Bachelors in engineering or computer science. DXC Platform Proficiency (Required) DXC ROMS (Reusable Orchestration Modules) — primary automation orchestration platform: agentless architecture, RHEL base OS, PostgreSQL database, Jenkins pipelines, Ansible playbooks versioned in Git Execution modes: scheduled, human-triggered, ticket-triggered (PARES), mail-triggered (MaMI), API-based HA deployment: RHEL Pacemaker clustering, PostgreSQL synchronous replication DXC Arise — Level 1.5 Agentic AI integration for autonomous incident triage and automated ticket enrichment DXC OASIS — Single pane of glass management plane for cross-platform analytics Observability-Driven Automation (Required) Dynatrace closed-loop automation: Davis AI detection → webhook → ROMS → Ansible playbook execution → Dynatrace Metrics API validation SolarWinds-triggered network automation
